name: helix
description: Helix Constitution action directives as native slash commands. Exposes every §11.4.140 registered action (BACKGROUND, REMINDER, ISSUE, BUG, TASK, ...) as /<name> plus the always-unambiguous /helix:<name> escape for host-command collisions. Commands are GENERATED from actions/registry.yaml — adding an action is a data change, never a code change.
